description: Claude 3.5 Sonnet is Anthropic's most intelligent model, offering the best combination of capability, speed, and cost. It excels at complex reasoning, coding, writing, and vision tasks while being faster than Claude 3 Opus.

primaryUses: Agentic coding and computer use tasks

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text and image data using Constitutional AI (CAI) methods. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Constitutional AI (CAI), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and extensive red-teaming for safety.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Outperforms Claude 3 Opus on most benchmarks while being faster and cheaper. State-of-the-art performance on coding, reasoning, and graduate-level knowledge tasks.

knownLimitations: May generate incorrect or misleading information
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff date
Can exhibit biases present in training data
May refuse some legitimate requests due to safety measures
Cannot browse the internet or access real-time information

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Anthropic uses Constitutional AI to reduce harmful outputs and biases. Regular evaluations conducted for bias detection.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Constitutional AI training, extensive red-teaming, content filtering, and usage policies enforcement.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data is not used to train models by default. Enterprise options available for additional privacy.

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Anthropic), also available via AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
